nodes.label: AI Accelerator
nodes.what: Target system under X-Ray: next-gen GPU/ASIC accelerator package.
nodes.why_matters: Economic question unit — scaling this system exposes binding physical constraints.

nodes.label: Compute Die / ASIC / GPU
nodes.what: Logic silicon that performs matrix/tensor compute.
nodes.why_matters: Defines demand for HBM, packaging, interconnect, and thermal envelope.

nodes.label: Chiplets
nodes.what: Disaggregated die modules assembled into one package.
nodes.why_matters: Shifts pressure onto interconnect, bonding, and advanced packaging yield.

nodes.label: HBM Capacity
nodes.what: High-bandwidth stacked DRAM attached near the compute die.
nodes.why_matters: Often binding for accelerator bandwidth and memory capacity scaling.

nodes.label: HBM Base Die / Interface
nodes.what: Logic/base die and memory interface attaching HBM stacks.
nodes.why_matters: Can limit stack height, bandwidth, and package integration even when DRAM wafer supply exists.

nodes.label: Advanced Packaging
nodes.why_matters: Joins compute + HBM + substrates; scarce capacity can dominate ramp.

nodes.label: Substrate / Interposer
nodes.what: Silicon/organic interposers and substrates carrying dense interconnect.
nodes.why_matters: Physical carrier for die attach; yield and supply can bind after packaging slots open.

nodes.label: Bonding / Test / Metrology
nodes.what: Hybrid bonding, inspection, metrology, and package test steps.
nodes.why_matters: Yield and throughput gates for stacked and multi-die packages.

nodes.label: High-Speed Electrical I/O
nodes.what: SerDes / electrical package and board interconnect.
nodes.why_matters: Bandwidth and reach limits force architectural tradeoffs before optics.

nodes.label: Optical I/O / CPO
nodes.what: Silicon photonics and co-packaged optics for package/rack bandwidth.
nodes.why_matters: Candidate next wall after electrical I/O and package density improve.

nodes.label: Thermal Density
nodes.what: Package and cold-plate thermal limits including TIM interfaces.
nodes.why_matters: Power density can bind even when silicon and memory supply exist.

nodes.label: Critical Lithography Equipment
nodes.what: Leading-edge lithography tools required for advanced nodes and related flows.
nodes.why_matters: Long-lead capital equipment can constrain upstream wafer starts.
